research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Matterport is researching systems for capturing and aligning three-dimensional scenes, as described in Capturing and aligning three-dimensional scenes, and methods for generating panoramic three-dimensional models, as in System and method of capturing and generating panoramic three-dimensional models. Their work includes processing and transmitting 3D data associated with 3D models of interior environments and integrating object detection and interactive 3D models. These areas reflect Matterport’s focus on immersive 3D digital twin technologies.
